title: benchmark-harness: unify dataset ingestion and runner-adapter for deterministic profile artifacts
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Reduce nondeterminism and engineering friction when producing performance profiles during model onboarding. Deliver a unified dataset ingestion pipeline that preserves seedable sampling, a compact prompt-transformation layer with provenance metadata, and a lightweight runner-adapter that normalizes outputs across eval runtimes so published profiles are reproducible and small artifact blobs are easy to pin by model-version.

Scope:
- Dataset ingest adapter that emits: canonical manifest, deterministic seed bank, and sampling recipe.
- Prompt-transform DSL that records transformations applied (truncate/concat/shot-order) and supports deterministic variant expansion.
- Eval runner-adapter shim to normalize runner-specific outputs (timing, rounding, tokenization differences) into a shared runner result schema.
- Profile artifact format: compressed manifest + metrics + provenance (model version, seed bank, runner adapter version) and a content-hash for pinning.

Acceptance criteria:
- Repro runs with same manifest+seed+adapter+runner produce identical profile blobs (byte-equality of core metrics payload) for 95% of test cases across 3 runner types.
- Nightly onboarding job switches to new ingestion pipeline; no >4% regression in previously measured latency profiles.
- New profile artifacts include provenance fields and small content-hash for deterministic pinning in catalog.

Design decisions & trade-offs:
- Deterministic seeding will prioritize reproducibility over perfect statistical randomness; downstream UX will include recommended larger-sample re-runs for variance estimates.
- We add a thin adapter layer on top of existing eval runners rather than replacing them to minimize disruption; this centralizes normalization logic but adds one more version to track.
- Chose a compact JSONL+zstd profile blob format for compatibility with existing tooling; avoided binary protobuf to keep onboarding debugging accessible to engineers.

Integration touchpoints:
- runtime onboarding job: pipeline switch flag + compatibility tests.
- model catalog: accept new artifact metadata fields and content-hash for model-version pinning.
- console: expose provenance and diff view for profile regressions.

Follow-ups (post-merge):
- UI work to display seed bank and transformation diffs (PM + Design ticket).
- Auto-re-run harness mode to compute confidence intervals (future PR).
